rationale: Parent 0.9672; R4 frontier 0.9688 (conciseness edit to section_summary.md) already baked into scaffold. Only summary_quality (0.934) has headroom (0.034); schema_adherence and output_json_valid at 1.0 have zero upside and real downside (R9 cosmetic output_schema edit −0.047 by dropping 1 row to 0/0/0 on both perfect judges). Four summary_quality sub-criteria mined exhaustively: conciseness R4 KEEP +0.0016 (in scaffold); completeness/coverage R1 REVERT −0.106 (32k truncation on finra_5210/5310); faithfulness no-invention R6 REVERT −0.105 (same cascade on finra_4512/5210); schema-sketch brevity R9 REVERT −0.047. Only unmined sub-criterion is accuracy, but every content path (normative-modality phrasing, defined-term capitalization, additional verbatim-quoting) was tried in R1 or structurally overlaps section_summary.md's existing 'preserves key legal terms, rule cross-references, dates, thresholds, and party names verbatim' bullet, and added length pressure reliably reproduces the R1/R6 truncation cascade on the same rows. Edits to hierarchy/citations/exclusions/identity target judges already at 1.0 or clash with section_summary (R9 proved cosmetic structural edits fragile). Sampling exhausted: R3 T=0.0 noop; lowering max_tokens reinvites truncation; narrowing top_p at T=0.1 has no mechanism; max_tool_calls=0 with empty tools has no mechanism. delete_rule on no_repeat_failed_mutations.md (applies_to: optimizer) has zero runtime effect. Adding a new skill/rule reproduces the legacy R6 clash pattern (−0.194). EV: 1 kept gain +0.0016 vs 3 content reverts avg −0.086 (54x asymmetric downside). R7/R8/R10/R11/R12/R14/R15/R16/R17/R18 reached the same conclusion. Noop preserves the R4 frontier (0.9688) and a clean parent for a future round when per-example sub-criterion telemetry becomes available to localize the accuracy leak on the 14/20 examples at 0.8125–0.9375.
